name: Sigvara
description: Sigvara computes a reputation score for AI agents on top of ERC-8004 and puts a slashable bond behind it. An oracle computes each score from payments verified on chain, outcomes reported for those payments, tenure, and ERC-8004 feedback from reviewers that paid the agent, and proposes it to a contract on Arc. A second operator recomputes each proposal and compares, and a committee can slash a bond. Both operators are run by the same team today. Finalized scores are on chain in SigvaraReputation; https://oracle.sigvara.xyz/score/{didHash} previews the next one. Arc testnet (chain 5042002) only, with no external audit. A score is not an audit, insurance or a guarantee.
